notes.title: Dungeons of Edera 2 Alpha Play Test is now OPEN!
notes.content:
Mercs,

The alpha play test for Dungeons of Edera is NOW OPEN! We will keep it open for approximately 2 weeks. If you do participate, please leave feedback and report bugs in our discord!


[h1]As a reminder[/h1]

It will be single player only for this first test, on our static test map (Our dungeon generation is still WIP). Players will be limited to the Paladin Class (With all spells available for unlock - Advanced spells in the future will have level gating) and most of the Hub features are not available except for stash/store. We will keep the play test open for approximately 2 weeks.

[h2]Goals of this early test are[/h2]
Early feedback on core gameplay loop
Combat/spells/level up feedback
Early performance signals on various hardware
Overall look and feel feedback
Ideas to enhance the user experience


[h2]How do I sign up[/h2]
Opt into the play test on the main Dungeons of Edera 2 steam page!


[h3]Our ask is if you do check it out, you give us feedback on the survey that is available in the main menu!
Looking forward to hearing your feedback![/h3]

Cheers,
Monster Tooth
